info.cls_ename: Master Program of Green Energy Science and Technology
info.sub_ename: DESIGN FOR WIND AND SOLAR ENERGY

description.sub_ename: DESIGN FOR WIND AND SOLAR ENERGY
description.describe_ch: 本課程首先說明各種能源目前使用的概況，以及再生能源的發展及其相關實場之操作，同時培養環境保護及人文關懷的世界觀；接著，才以專案設計模式學習如何設計風光能源模廠，並配合實際參訪或實作進一步了解。
description.describe_eh: This course explains the current situation of various energy sources firstly, and then introduces the development of renewable energy and related field operations. At the same time, this course cultivates a world view of environmental protection and humanistic care. Then, the case design mode is used for learning how to build a solar / wind energy pilot plant in a real project.
